Ezreal.build: Build attack speed and critical strike first to strengthen Zeri Q Burst Fire. Ezreal Q Mystic Shot deals physical damage, while Ezreal W Essence Flux and Ezreal E Arcane Shift deal magic damage, so if you need defenses, don’t focus on just one type of resistance.
Ezreal.watch: Dodge Ezreal Q Mystic Shot by keeping a minion between you and him. If Ezreal W Essence Flux marks you, briefly move out of range to avoid the follow-up attack. When your health is low, keep Ezreal R Trueshot Barrage in mind and don’t retreat in a straight line with your allies.
Ezreal.combo: Make Ezreal use Ezreal E Arcane Shift first, then slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. Repeatedly fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, prepared with Zeri E Spark Surge, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking in the fight.
Ezreal.escape: Go in right after Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used. If Ezreal Q Mystic Shot keeps landing, Ezreal E Arcane Shift comes back sooner, so move behind minions in the meantime.
Ezreal.fight: Instead of trading harass from long range, close the gap while dodging Ezreal Q Mystic Shot behind minions. Pressure him briefly to draw out Ezreal E Arcane Shift, then slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and approach with Zeri E Spark Surge to follow up with Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Ezreal.laning: Move along the inside of the minion wave to block Ezreal Q Mystic Shot, and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to harass when you have an angle to hit a wall and spread it, but don’t overextend and face Ezreal in the open.
Ezreal.phase: Early on, dodge Ezreal’s ranged harass and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Zeri’s damage rises sharply after she builds attack speed and critical strike in the mid game, so look for fights where you can keep attacking in the late game too.
Ezreal.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank, and take a position beside a wall to set up an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Close the gap when Ezreal E Arcane Shift has been used, then activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking.

Aphelios.teamfight: Spread out from allies so several of you don’t get hit by Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil. From a flank beside a wall, keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire while setting up an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. When Aphelios isn’t holding Severum, look for a chance to approach with Zeri E Spark Surge and pick him off first.
Aphelios.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Aphelios deals mostly physical damage, and Zeri has low armor, so build armor first. If Aphelios’s healing makes the duel drag on, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Aphelios.combo: Dodge Aphelios’s Gravitum root before going in. Slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then approach with Zeri E Spark Surge. Follow up by repeatedly firing piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking.
Aphelios.escape: The window to engage opens after Aphelios uses the Gravitum root from Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites. If he isn’t holding Severum, he has no way to escape other than Flash, so close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. If you need to retreat instead, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Aphelios.fight: Check the next weapon shown on Aphelios E Weapon Queue System, and trade when he has a weapon with low burst damage. After dodging Gravitum’s slow and Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites root, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. If you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire during the fight, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and fight.
Aphelios.laning: Early on, don’t force your way to the front; keep moving and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. When Aphelios is backed against a wall or in a narrow passage, harass him by hitting terrain with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Back away when marked by Calibrum so you don’t keep losing health to its mark.
Aphelios.phase: Early on, Zeri should focus on farming while watching Aphelios’s weapons and marks instead of forcing kills. Zeri gets stronger in the mid game after building two or three attack speed and critical strike core items, so look for fights when Aphelios has a weapon with low burst damage. In the late game, keep checking Aphelios’s weapon state and find a position where you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Aphelios.watch: If Aphelios slows you with his Gravitum basic attack, Aphelios Q Weapon Abilites can follow with a root, so immediately move out of range. Aphelios R Moonlight Vigil hits champions with an additional attack from his main-hand weapon, so spread out from allies when he can use it. If marked by his Calibrum, you can be hit by an extra attack even outside its range, so back away immediately.

Samira.combo: After Samira W Blade Whirl ends and Samira E Wild Rush is down, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Then fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire shots in succession, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Samira.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first, considering Samira’s main damage and Zeri’s low armor.
Samira.escape: The moment after you make Samira use Samira E Wild Rush is your window to engage. If you’ve also avoided the enemy support’s crowd control, close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. If Samira closes in instead, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. When retreating, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Samira.fight: When Samira walks in, use the slow from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to create distance, then damage her with Zeri Q Burst Fire after Samira W Blade Whirl ends. After Samira uses Samira E Wild Rush, fight during the window when her dash has not reset if nobody died.
Samira.laning: Don’t force your way to the front; keep moving and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and expand it into a laser, but save it as a slow if Samira can engage. Manage the path Samira would take to walk into melee range while building up CS.
Samira.phase: Early on, Zeri should farm while stopping Samira from engaging at close range rather than forcing kills. In the mid game, build up CS toward two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike. Zeri’s damage rises sharply after that, so fight from positions where you can keep attacking.
Samira.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall, securing an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. If an ally is caught by crowd control, adjust your distance with the expectation that Samira may close in on them with Samira P Daredevil Impulse. If Samira dashes in and nobody dies, that’s your window to attack; when retreating, don’t leave a low health ally behind.
Samira.watch: While Samira W Blade Whirl is spinning, it destroys projectiles, so don’t use Zeri Q Burst Fire; wait for the spin to end. If you’re hit by the enemy support’s crowd control, Samira can close in immediately with Samira P Daredevil Impulse, so dodge the initiating ability. If Samira stays in melee range and keeps attacking, she can build up to cast Samira R Inferno Trigger, so keep your time in her range brief.

Kaisa.escape: If you’re hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker and marked, don’t go in; retreat toward your allies.
Kaisa.build: Buy Cloth Armor early to survive, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first against Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain and her basic attacks. Also remember that armor won’t block the magic damage from Kai'Sa P Second Skin and Kai'Sa W Void Seeker.
Kaisa.combo: If you can use a wall, slow her first with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and prepare piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire. If you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire in the fight, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and keep attacking as you build movement speed.
Kaisa.fight: Slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and follow up with Zeri Q Burst Fire. While Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct is available, watch for a wall-crossing escape route when using Zeri E Spark Surge.
Kaisa.laning: After that, don’t overextend; farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and spread it, but consider whether you should save the slow if Kai'Sa can go in.
Kaisa.phase: Keep farming in the mid game until Zeri has built attack speed and critical strike. After completing two or three core items, use Zeri’s increased mobility to find fights where you can keep attacking.
Kaisa.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank beside a wall while setting up both an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Place Control Wards in the flanking bushes and approach routes before the fight to prepare for Kai'Sa E Supercharge’s stealth. If Kai'Sa goes in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, let her engage pass, and when allies can apply immobilizing crowd control, attack together before the shield is removed.
Kaisa.watch: If you’re hit by Kai'Sa W Void Seeker, she can go in with Kai'Sa R Killer Instinct, so retreat toward your allies until the mark disappears. Kai'Sa P Second Skin deals more damage as health gets lower, so if stacks build up, wait out their duration from outside her range. Stay near minions when hit by Kai'Sa Q Icathian Rain so the missiles spread out.

Ashe.fight: Trade right after Ashe W Volley is used. Keep your distance while Ashe Q Ranger's Focus is active, then close the gap at once with Zeri E Spark Surge after it ends. Ashe has no mobility skill, so once you get close, keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Ashe.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive early. Ashe deals mostly physical damage and Zeri has relatively low armor, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Ashe.combo: Once Ashe W Volley has been used and Ashe Q Ranger's Focus has ended, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, repeatedly fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash. Keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active when you can keep attacking.
Ashe.escape: The opportunity to go in with Zeri E Spark Surge comes after Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow has been used. Ashe has no mobility skill, so if Ashe W Volley has also been used, close the gap at once.
Ashe.laning: Early on, don’t overextend; clear minions and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Keep moving to dodge harass, and harass Ashe with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle against a wall. Avoid extended trades until Ashe W Volley has been used.
Ashe.phase: Early on, farm with Zeri while watching out for Ashe’s slow harass. Zeri gets stronger from the point when she has two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike in the mid game, so look for chances to fight. In late-game team fights, keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active and find a position where you can keep attacking.
Ashe.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank instead of from the front. Take a position beside a wall to set up both an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Keep changing direction so Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow doesn’t hit and stun you.
Ashe.watch: Ashe W Volley is an area slow, so move to the side of its cone to dodge it. Ashe P Frost Shot’s slow refreshes with every basic attack, so don’t stay within her attack range for long. Ashe R Enchanted Crystal Arrow can stun you, so don’t start a small fight from out of vision while her ultimate is available; change direction to dodge it when it comes.

Draven.laning: Don’t force your way to the front; farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to harass when you have an angle against a wall, but save it for a slow if there’s a risk Draven will close in. If trading is difficult, farm without giving up a kill and wait for your jungler to have an opening to gank.
Draven.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first to withstand Draven’s physical damage. Choose Plated Steelcaps for boots and build armor first.
Draven.combo: When his axes are reduced, slow Draven with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. Follow up by repeatedly firing piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking.
Draven.escape: Go in with Zeri E Spark Surge when Draven E Stand Aside has been used and he has one or fewer axes. If you need to retreat, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Draven.fight: Don’t fight if Draven is holding two axes. Fire Zeri W Ultrashock Laser at the spot where an axe will land: if he goes to catch it, he gets hit; if he dodges, he loses the axe. Try trading when he has one or fewer axes.
Draven.phase: Early on, Draven’s axe damage is strong, so Zeri should focus on farming safely. Zeri’s power rises sharply after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike. After laning, look for Draven when he’s alone, together with your team.
Draven.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank beside a wall while setting up an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. When you can keep attacking multiple enemies, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash, and fire Zeri W Ultrashock Laser at the spot where Draven will go to catch an axe.
Draven.watch: Avoid early trades while Draven is maintaining two Draven Q Spinning Axe. Watch out for the slow and forced movement from Draven E Stand Aside, and don’t stand in the return path after dodging Draven R Whirling Death.

Caitlyn.phase: Caitlyn is strong early, so avoid giving up kills and build your CS. Zeri gets stronger as she completes attack speed and critical strike core items in the mid game. Caitlyn gets relatively weaker as the game goes on, so use Zeri’s mobility to find a position where you can keep attacking.
Caitlyn.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game to withstand Caitlyn’s mainly physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Caitlyn.combo: When you have an angle against a wall, slow her first with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, approach with Zeri E Spark Surge, then repeatedly fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire. If you can keep attacking during the fight, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and continue attacking.
Caitlyn.escape: Avoid approaching through paths with Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap. When you need to retreat, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Caitlyn.fight: Slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser by using a wall, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, then follow up with Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Caitlyn.laning: Early on, respect Caitlyn’s strong laning and long range. Don’t force your way forward; farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Harass with Zeri P Living Battery charged by moving and Zeri W Ultrashock Laser spread off a wall, but don’t force kills. Even if you fall behind, hold on and farm under your turret.
Caitlyn.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank beside a wall instead of standing in front. From there, set up both an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route over a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge. When you can keep attacking multiple enemies, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash to maintain the movement speed increase.
Caitlyn.watch: If you step on Caitlyn W Yordle Snap Trap, you’ll be rooted in place and exposed to Caitlyn P Headshot’s long range and empowered attack, so watch for traps in bushes and narrow passages. When Caitlyn harasses with Caitlyn Q Piltover Peacemaker, stand behind an allied minion to take reduced damage.

Jhin.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Jhin deals mostly physical damage and Zeri has low armor, so build armor first.
Jhin.combo: If Jhin has fired his last shot and is reloading, or Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, repeatedly fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Jhin.escape: Jhin has no skill to create distance himself, so go in with Zeri E Spark Surge during a window when Jhin W Deadly Flourish has been used and he has fired his last shot. If a root or trap puts you in danger, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and escape over a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Jhin.fight: Look to trade while Jhin is reloading or after he has fired one or two shots, and keep your distance if he has his last shot. After Jhin W Deadly Flourish misses, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and follow up with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash in a fight where you can keep attacking to benefit from the movement speed and rapid fire.
Jhin.laning: Early on, keep moving to charge Zeri P Living Battery and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire instead of stepping forward to look for kills. Stand a short distance from low-health minions because Jhin Q Dancing Grenade can bounce harder after killing one. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and spread it, and avoid getting rooted by Jhin W Deadly Flourish while standing on one of Jhin’s traps.
Jhin.phase: Early on, Zeri should build CS and avoid risky trades because of Jhin’s last shot and Jhin W Deadly Flourish. Zeri’s power rises sharply after she gets two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike in the mid game.
Jhin.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank beside a wall, while setting up both an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. When advancing toward Jhin, follow after your frontline has stepped on the traps and taken Jhin W Deadly Flourish. If someone needs to block shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, have the ally with the highest health percentage take them, while Zeri moves to avoid being hit at low health.
Jhin.watch: The last shot of Jhin P Whisper deals heavy damage, so count his remaining shots and back away when he has one left. Right after you’re hit by Jhin’s basic attack or Jhin E Captive Audience trap, watch out for the root from Jhin W Deadly Flourish and move out of its line. When your health is low, dodge shots from Jhin R Curtain Call, which grow stronger based on your missing health.

Jinx.build: Buy Cloth Armor first to survive early. Jinx deals mostly physical damage, so build armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Jinx.combo: When going in, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and prepare to pierce. Follow up by repeatedly landing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Jinx.escape: The opportunity to go in comes when Jinx W Zap! misses or after Jinx E Flame Chompers! has been used. Jinx has no skill to create distance herself, so close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge then.
Jinx.fight: Jinx has no minigun attack speed stacks while harassing with rockets, so look for short trade windows. If Jinx E Flame Chompers! has been used, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Jinx.laning: Early on, don’t overextend; clear the wave and build CS with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Don’t stand on top of minions, so you can avoid Jinx’s rocket harass, and use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and spread it.
Jinx.phase: Early on, Zeri should avoid forcing kills and build CS while dodging harass. Zeri’s power rises sharply after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike, so look for fights where you can keep attacking in the mid to late game.
Jinx.teamfight: Take a position on a flank beside a wall and keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire while setting up an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to spread off terrain and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep hitting enemy champions and maintaining its effect. Don’t start a fight right after Jinx P Get Excited! triggers from a takedown or structure destruction.
Jinx.watch: Jinx Q Switcheroo! rockets also damage units around the target, so don’t stand beside a minion when Jinx attacks it. Avoid Jinx E Flame Chompers! because getting rooted by them is dangerous, and if health has decreased, stay out of range of Jinx R Super Mega Death Rocket!.

Kalista.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to hold out and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first to protect against the physical damage from Kalista Q Pierce and Kalista E Rend.
Kalista.combo: To engage, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge, then land consecutive piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire shots. If you can keep attacking, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and continue using Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Kalista.escape: Look to engage when Kalista R Fate's Call is down and no spears have stacked up. When Kalista begins an attack, anticipate the moment to hit her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. When you need to retreat, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Kalista.fight: Kalista must begin an attack to leap with Kalista P Martial Poise, so anticipate that moment and fire Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Don’t keep trading while several spears are lodged. After Kalista R Fate's Call is down, look for an angle to close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Kalista.laning: Don’t force your way forward with your short range. Keep moving and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and expand it into a laser, but save it as a slow if Kalista might engage. If spears have stacked up, retreat into brush or behind a wall to break vision and manage your health.
Kalista.phase: Early on, Zeri should focus on farming and staying safe rather than forcing kills. She gets stronger after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike, so look for fights where you can keep attacking from then on. Even in the late game, don’t let a fight drag on while spears are stacked up.
Kalista.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall, and secure an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. If Kalista’s support stays close, spread out to respect Kalista R Fate's Call. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking.
Kalista.watch: Kalista E Rend deals its damage after several spears have lodged, so when spears stack up and health decreases, stop fighting and back away until the spears disappear. Kalista R Fate's Call can pull in and throw her support, so spread out to avoid the landing area when the support stays close to Kalista.

KogMaw.build: Build attack speed and critical strike to increase the damage of Zeri Q Burst Fire. If you build resistances, consider magic resistance first against Kog'Maw’s magic damage, and also consider armor against his basic attack damage. Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage deals damage based on your maximum health, so don’t rely on stacking health alone.
KogMaw.combo: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and approach with Zeri E Spark Surge. After Zeri E Spark Surge, fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire shots in succession, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
KogMaw.escape: Kog'Maw has no mobility, so avoid the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze and engage with Zeri E Spark Surge when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. When you need to retreat, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
KogMaw.fight: Close the distance and fight after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. Avoid the slow from Kog'Maw E Void Ooze, then slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, approach with Zeri E Spark Surge, and continue using Zeri Q Burst Fire.
KogMaw.laning: Early on, Zeri should keep moving to avoid poke and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire rather than force her way forward. Poke Kog'Maw with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you can hit a wall and expand it into a laser, and postpone trades while Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active.
KogMaw.phase: Early on, Zeri should focus on farming and look to trade only when Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires. In the mid game, Zeri gets stronger after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike, so make use of that damage. Kog'Maw also gets stronger over time, so secure objectives and towers in the early and mid game and aim to end quickly.
KogMaw.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall, and secure an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Look for a chance to approach after Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage expires, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking. After killing Kog'Maw, move away from his corpse to avoid the explosion from Kog'Maw P Icathian Surprise.
KogMaw.watch: When Kog'Maw W Bio-Arcane Barrage is active, its range and damage based on your maximum health increase, so keep your distance until it expires. Kog'Maw Q Caustic Spittle reduces armor and magic resistance, so block it with minions or sidestep; if it hits, avoid trading for a while. When your health is low, Kog'Maw R Living Artillery deals more damage, so leave vision and recover.

Lucian.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor to hold out and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first because Lucian’s main damage is physical and Zeri has low armor. Armor does not block the magic damage from Lucian W Ardent Blaze.
Lucian.combo: After Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is down, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Then fire Zeri Q Burst Fire in succession with the piercing effect prepared by Zeri E Spark Surge, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash. Keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active in fights where you can keep landing hits.
Lucian.escape: The moment after you make Lucian use Lucian E Relentless Pursuit is your window to engage with Zeri E Spark Surge. If the enemy support has shielded or healed Lucian, or someone on your team has been immobilized, empowering Lucian’s next two shots, back off briefly before engaging.
Lucian.fight: After letting Lucian’s opening combo pass, extend the fight when his abilities are down. Right after Lucian uses Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge and continue with Zeri Q Burst Fire. If you let Lucian trade basic attacks for too long, Lucian E Relentless Pursuit comes back quickly, so don’t miss your window to engage.
Lucian.laning: Don’t force your way to the front early; clear waves and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Move out of the line behind minions to avoid Lucian Q Piercing Light’s piercing poke. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and expand it into a laser, and save it for the slow if Lucian could close in.
Lucian.phase: In the early game, Zeri should farm while watching for Lucian’s explosive opening combo. The mid game depends on whether Zeri has two or three attack speed and critical strike core items; her power rises sharply after that. In the late game, look for extended fights where you can keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active and continue landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Lucian.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the flank rather than standing in front. Holding a position near a wall gives you an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. If Lucian R The Culling is aimed at you, sidestep; keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active when you can continue attacking.
Lucian.watch: Lucian Q Piercing Light passes through minions and reaches beyond its indicated range, so move out of the line behind a minion when Lucian attacks one. When Lucian R The Culling starts, sidestep instead of running straight back. After Lucian E Relentless Pursuit, watch for his opening combo with empowered basic attacks.

MissFortune.build: Early on, buy Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first because Miss Fortune’s main damage is physical and Zeri has low armor. Armor does not apply to the magic damage from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain.
MissFortune.combo: To engage, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. After E, fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire shots in succession, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking.
MissFortune.escape: Miss Fortune has no mobility, so engage with Zeri E Spark Surge during a window when the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is down. If Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is active or she uses Miss Fortune R Bullet Time, stop your engage and move to the side or out of the area. When you need to break off a chase, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
MissFortune.fight: Keep your distance right after Miss Fortune attacks a minion, when you’re likely to be hit by an empowered basic attack. Once the slow from Miss Fortune E Make It Rain is gone and you can fight outside its area, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Then activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
MissFortune.laning: Don’t force your way to the front early; clear waves and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Don’t stand in line with a minion so Miss Fortune Q Double Up won’t bounce to you. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have a wall angle, and make use of basic attacks charged by moving.
MissFortune.phase: Early on, Zeri should farm while avoiding Miss Fortune’s poke rather than forcing kills. Her power rises greatly after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike, so from the mid game onward, look for fights where you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire. In the late game, fight from a position where you can keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active and continue attacking.
MissFortune.teamfight: Don’t engage inside an area covered by Miss Fortune E Make It Rain, and when Miss Fortune R Bullet Time starts, move to the side of its fixed cone. Keep using Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall, securing an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and build up movement speed when you can keep attacking.
MissFortune.watch: Miss Fortune Q Double Up hits its first target and then bounces backward, so don’t stand directly behind a minion. Leave the area of Miss Fortune E Make It Rain so you don’t get hit by Miss Fortune R Bullet Time while slowed. Miss Fortune R Bullet Time’s direction is fixed when cast, so move out to the side of its cone.

Nilah.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first because Nilah’s main damage is physical, but also build health to account for the penetration from Nilah Q Formless Blade. If Nilah P Joy Unending, Q Formless Blade, and R Apotheosis keep healing her through an extended duel, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items.
Nilah.combo: When Nilah W Jubilant Veil ends and you can respond to her engage, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Use E to prepare the piercing effect for your next Q, then fire Zeri Q Burst Fire in succession. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Nilah.escape: Nilah E Slipstream has a short cooldown, so don’t engage just because her E is down. Once Nilah has engaged and spent W Jubilant Veil and E, close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge if your team can lock her down with immobilizing crowd control. If there’s a high risk of being pulled by Nilah R Apotheosis or you need to create distance, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and cross a wall with E.
Nilah.fight: If Nilah closes in with Nilah E Slipstream, use the slow from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to create distance and keep attacking with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Don’t fire Q repeatedly while Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active; wait for its duration to end. If Nilah’s W and E are down and you can keep attacking, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and build up movement speed as you fight.
Nilah.laning: After that, don’t force your way to the front. Keep moving to charge Zeri P Living Battery and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall and expand it into a laser, but save it to slow Nilah if you need to stop her engage.
Nilah.phase: In the mid game, build up CS with Zeri Q Burst Fire and stop Nilah’s engages instead of forcing kills. Zeri gets stronger after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike, so look for fights where you can keep attacking from then on.
Nilah.teamfight: Keep your distance from allies so several of you aren’t caught by Nilah R Apotheosis, and keep using Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall. From there, secure an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Once Nilah has engaged and spent W Jubilant Veil and E Slipstream, attack in sync with your team’s immobilizing crowd control. If R has already pulled you in, attack Nilah immediately to prevent her from channeling it to completion.
Nilah.watch: When Nilah Q Formless Blade hits, Nilah briefly gains increased attack range and attacks in a cone, so take another step back. Watch out for angles where Nilah can close in with Nilah E Slipstream. When Nilah W Jubilant Veil is active, stop using Zeri Q Burst Fire, which counts as a basic attack, and resume after the veil ends. Nilah R Apotheosis can pull in several players and heal her team, so keep your distance from allies while she has R available.

Senna.build: Buy Cloth Armor early and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Build armor first because Senna’s main damage is physical. Fit Executioner's Calling between your core items to counter the healing from Senna Q Piercing Darkness.
Senna.combo: If you can use a wall, slow Senna with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Follow with consecutive hits from piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Senna.escape: Look to engage the moment Senna W Last Embrace misses or is blocked by a minion and you avoid the root. Close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge, but reassess the chase if Senna E Curse of the Black Mist has increased her movement speed.
Senna.fight: Look for a chance to close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge after Senna W Last Embrace misses or is blocked by a minion. After Zeri E Spark Surge, you can attack Senna even behind minions with piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire. Don’t chase recklessly while Senna E Curse of the Black Mist increases her movement speed.
Senna.laning: Rather than forcing your way to the front, keep moving to avoid poke and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Watch where Senna’s souls fall, and poke her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser expanded into a laser by hitting a wall when she comes out to collect them. Avoid Senna Q Piercing Darkness’s straight-line poke and her second attack while disrupting her soul collection.
Senna.phase: Early on, Senna has low health and you can stop her from collecting souls, but Zeri should prioritize farming over forcing kills. Zeri’s power rises sharply in the mid game once she has two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike. If Senna collects many souls, her attack damage and range increase in the late game, so disrupting her collection early is important.
Senna.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall, securing an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. If you see Senna E Curse of the Black Mist, retreat to a place with vision or fire Zeri W Ultrashock Laser into its area. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and build up movement speed when you can keep attacking.
Senna.watch: Senna Q Piercing Darkness passes through allies or minions, so move out of the line between Senna and her target. Dodge Senna W Last Embrace from behind minions, and if it hits and marks you, move away from allies before the root triggers. If Senna hits you once, retreat to avoid a second attack and prevent her from collecting mist.

Seraphine.build: Build core items with attack speed and critical strike so you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire. If healing from Seraphine W Surround Sound lets them survive the fight, fit Executioner's Calling between your core items. Build magic resistance rather than armor to defend against Seraphine’s damage.
Seraphine.combo: When Seraphine E Beat Drop is down, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Follow with consecutive Zeri Q Burst Fire shots, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Seraphine.escape: When engaging, look for the moment Seraphine E Beat Drop misses or is down; Seraphine has no mobility ability. When you need to retreat while dodging Seraphine’s crowd control, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Seraphine.fight: The moment after dodging Seraphine E Beat Drop is a chance to close the distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. Trade when Seraphine is alone and separated from her allies, then follow Zeri E Spark Surge with piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Seraphine.laning: Don’t force your way to the front early. Keep moving to avoid poke and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to poke when you have an angle to hit a wall and expand it into a laser, and don’t engage recklessly with Zeri E Spark Surge while Seraphine E Beat Drop is available.
Seraphine.phase: Early on, Zeri benefits from avoiding Seraphine’s poke and building CS rather than forcing kills. Her power rises sharply in the mid game after two or three core items with attack speed and critical strike, so actively take opportunities when Seraphine E Beat Drop is down. In the late game too, make the most of Zeri R Lightning Crash in fights where you can keep attacking.
Seraphine.teamfight: Avoid standing in a line with your allies to reduce the angles where Seraphine R Encore can reach everyone behind you. Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flanking position near a wall, and secure an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to expand into a laser on hitting the wall and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash to make use of its movement and attack speed when you can keep hitting enemy champions.
Seraphine.watch: Seraphine E Beat Drop roots slowed targets and stuns immobilized targets.

Sivir.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Sivir’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Since Sivir E Spell Shield has a healing effect, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Sivir.combo: Feint an engage to bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first. Then slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, and prepare a piercing attack before firing Zeri Q Burst Fire repeatedly. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if the fight lets you keep attacking.
Sivir.escape: Engage with Zeri E Spark Surge when Sivir E Spell Shield is down. Sivir has no mobility skill to create distance, so look for an opportunity to close the gap after Sivir R On The Hunt ends. When you need to disengage, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Sivir.fight: Bait out Sivir E Spell Shield first, then slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. Keep dealing damage with Zeri Q Burst Fire while dodging the outbound and return paths of Sivir Q Boomerang Blade. Avoid extended chases and keep trades short while Sivir R On The Hunt is active.
Sivir.laning: Don’t overextend early. Keep moving to dodge poke and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to hit a wall. Sivir clears waves quickly, so push the lane in advance before leaving, or make sure an ally is ready to catch the wave.
Sivir.phase: Early on, watch out for Sivir’s fast wave clear while Zeri builds up CS. From mid game onward, take more chances to fight once Zeri has two or three core attack speed and critical strike items. Zeri’s damage rises sharply after that, so fight when you can keep attacking.
Sivir.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side near a wall instead of standing in front. Use the wall to secure both a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Look for an engage when Sivir E Spell Shield is down, but while Sivir R On The Hunt is active, only take short fights around terrain and vision.
Sivir.watch: Sivir Q Boomerang Blade must be dodged on both its outbound and return paths, so move out of the way of the return path too. Watch out for the empowered attacks from Sivir W Ricochet, and don’t start an engage with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser while Sivir E Spell Shield is available. When Sivir R On The Hunt is active, the whole enemy team moves faster, so avoid extended chases.

Smolder.build: Survive Smolder’s physical damage early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps. If the healing from Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! helps withstand Zeri’s sustained damage, fit Executioner’s Calling between your core items.
Smolder.combo: When Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then approach with Zeri E Spark Surge and prepare to pierce him. Follow up by firing Zeri Q Burst Fire repeatedly, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if the fight lets you keep attacking.
Smolder.escape: Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is his only escape, so the window right after you force him to use it is your chance to engage. If Smolder W Achooo! has also missed, you have less reason to worry about being slowed, so close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Smolder.fight: Right after Smolder E Flap, Flap, Flap is down, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. Zeri Q Burst Fire after Zeri E Spark Surge pierces enemies, so use that angle to attack even if Smolder is behind minions.
Smolder.laning: While Smolder is weak early, dodge his poke and disrupt his farming to slow the growth of Smolder P Dragon Practice. Zeri has short range, so don’t overextend; clear the wave with Zeri Q Burst Fire and pressure him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle on a wall.
Smolder.phase: Smolder is weak early, so protect Zeri’s safe farming while disrupting Smolder’s farm. Zeri gets stronger after two or three core attack speed and critical strike items, but Smolder’s stacks accumulate permanently, giving him an increasing advantage as the game goes on. Secure objectives and towers quickly in mid game.
Smolder.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side near a wall, while securing both a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking. If Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! lands, leave its area and then attack again.
Smolder.watch: If Smolder W Achooo! hits, it slows you and grants stacks that help him scale, so dodge it by standing behind minions or moving to the side. Smolder R MMOOOMMMM! deals heavy damage at its center and heals Smolder, so leave its area and then re-engage. Smolder Q Super Scorcher Breath gains true damage and an execute when he has enough stacks, so avoid fighting at low health.

Tristana.combo: While Tristana W Rocket Jump and R Buster Shot are down, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and land Zeri Q Burst Fire to pierce her. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Tristana.escape: Engage right after Tristana W Rocket Jump is used. If Tristana R Buster Shot is also down, there is less risk of being stunned and knocked back as you close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Tristana.fight: The moment after Tristana W Rocket Jump is used is your chance to close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. Until then, farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire and poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you can use a wall. If you can keep the fight going, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Tristana.laning: Don’t overextend early. Keep moving and collect CS with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Stand apart from allied minions to avoid the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge. Tristana is weak early and has long cooldowns, so when you can push, shove the lane toward her tower to make last-hitting difficult.
Tristana.phase: Tristana is weak early, but Zeri should still build CS instead of forcing kills. Zeri gets stronger after two or three core attack speed and critical strike items. Tristana is difficult to handle with a completed build, so play to end the game before then.
Tristana.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side near a wall, while securing a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking. If an ally dies and Tristana W Rocket Jump could reset, retreat immediately.
Tristana.watch: Tristana W Rocket Jump is a dash that also slows, so don’t recklessly close the gap while it’s available. Tristana R Buster Shot stuns and knocks you back, so avoid engaging while this ability is available. Standing near allied minions can expose you to the area damage from Tristana E Explosive Charge.

TwistedFate.build: Prioritize core items that provide attack speed and critical strike. Build magic resistance rather than armor against Twisted Fate’s damage. If the enemy composition can lock Zeri down with targeted crowd control to start a fight, fit Quicksilver Sash or Mercurial Scimitar between your core items.
TwistedFate.combo: After Twisted Fate W Pick a Card consumes its gold card, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and approach with Zeri E Spark Surge. After Zeri E Spark Surge, fire Zeri Q Burst Fire repeatedly to pierce enemies. If the fight lets you keep attacking, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and continue attacking.
TwistedFate.escape: Engage with Zeri E Spark Surge when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down.
TwistedFate.fight: The moment after Twisted Fate W Pick a Card consumes its gold card is your chance to close in. Slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, then keep firing Zeri Q Burst Fire. Twisted Fate has relatively low armor, so Zeri’s main physical damage is effective against him.
TwistedFate.laning: Early on, don’t overextend. Clear the wave with Zeri Q Burst Fire and build up CS. Stand behind minions to dodge Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards, and use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to spread it off a wall.
TwistedFate.phase: Early on, focus on farming rather than forcing kills. Zeri becomes much stronger in mid game once she has two or three core attack speed and critical strike items, so fight when Twisted Fate W Pick a Card’s gold card is down. In late game, keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active and fight from a position where you can keep attacking.
TwistedFate.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side, but stay out of range of the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card. Holding a position near a wall gives you both a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. After Twisted Fate consumes his gold card, you can close in with Zeri E Spark Surge.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card has selected a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay out of range. Stand behind minions to reduce poke damage from Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards.

Twitch.build: Get a Control Ward early to prepare for Twitch Q Ambush. Twitch E Contaminate deals two types of damage, so no single resistance can block all of it, and resistance does not reduce the true damage from Twitch P Deadly Venom. Consider your total health and ways to lower Twitch’s attack speed, but the available information isn’t enough to determine a specific resistance or purchase order.
Twitch.combo: When Twitch’s camouflage ends and Twitch W Venom Cask is down, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge so your next Zeri Q Burst Fire pierces him. If you can keep attacking, activate Zeri R Lightning Crash and continue using Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Twitch.escape: Twitch has no skill to create distance on his own, so engage with Zeri E Spark Surge when his camouflage ends and Twitch W Venom Cask is down. Conversely, if Deadly Venom stacks up while you’re in Twitch W Venom Cask or you’re hit by several basic attacks, stop engaging and escape over a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Twitch.fight: If you’re hit by Twitch W Venom Cask or several basic attacks, create distance with Zeri E Spark Surge. After Twitch’s camouflage ends and Twitch W Venom Cask is down, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, and follow up with Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Twitch.laning: Early on, don’t overextend; collect minions with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you can use a wall, but save it as a slow if Twitch might approach. If Twitch disappears from lane, alert your allies and check bushes or narrow paths where you have no vision with a Control Ward.
Twitch.phase: Early on, Zeri should farm instead of forcing kills and watch out for surprise attacks from Twitch Q Ambush. From mid game onward, Zeri’s damage rises sharply once she has two or three core attack speed and critical strike items, so look to fight when Twitch’s camouflage ends. In late game, avoid the piercing attacks from Twitch R Spray and Pray and find a position where you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Twitch.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side near a wall, while securing a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, spread out to the side of his attack direction to avoid his piercing attacks. Focus the same target with your allies when Twitch’s camouflage ends or when he commits with Twitch R Spray and Pray, and keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active if you can keep attacking.
Twitch.watch: If Twitch appears nearby after hiding with Twitch Q Ambush, create distance before he lands several basic attacks. Leave the cloud from Twitch W Venom Cask immediately to limit Deadly Venom stacks and the finishing damage from Twitch E Contaminate. When Twitch R Spray and Pray is active, its range increases and his attacks pierce, so don’t line up with your allies.

Varus.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor. Build armor first against Varus’s main physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Don’t rely on stacking health as your only answer, since Varus W Blighted Quiver deals damage based on your maximum health.
Varus.combo: If you can use a wall, slow the enemy first with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge so your next Zeri Q Burst Fire pierces the enemy, and land Zeri Q Burst Fire repeatedly. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when the fight lets you keep attacking.
Varus.escape: The moment Varus R Chain of Corruption is down and Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow is your chance to engage with Zeri E Spark Surge. Varus has no skill to create distance on his own, so you can keep using Zeri Q Burst Fire after closing in. If you need to disengage, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Varus.fight: While Varus aims Varus Q Piercing Arrow, dodge sideways and look for a chance to close the gap. If Varus R Chain of Corruption is down, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, close in with Zeri E Spark Surge, and land Zeri Q Burst Fire repeatedly. If Blighted Quiver stacks are applied, back off first.
Varus.laning: Early on, don’t overextend; clear the wave with Zeri Q Burst Fire and collect CS. Use Zeri W Ultrashock Laser to poke when you have an angle to spread it off a wall, and save it as a slow if the enemy might engage. When Varus Q Piercing Arrow starts aiming, move sideways or hide behind minions.
Varus.phase: Early on, Zeri should dodge Varus’s poke and build CS instead of forcing kills. Zeri’s strength rises sharply after two or three core attack speed and critical strike items, so from then on look for fights where you can keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire. In late game, getting caught once is dangerous, so fight from the side near a wall.
Varus.teamfight: Take a position on the side near a wall and keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire, while securing both a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. If Varus R Chain of Corruption hits an ally, spread out so the tendrils don’t reach you. Briefly disengage right after Varus becomes stronger from a kill or assist, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking.
Varus.watch: If you’re hit by a skill while Blighted Quiver stacks are applied, Varus deals bonus damage based on your maximum health. If you’ve taken several basic attacks, back off and give the stacks time to expire. Move sideways out of the arrow’s path when you see Varus aiming Varus Q Piercing Arrow. Leave the area from Varus E Hail of Arrows, which reduces healing. If an ally is caught by Varus R Chain of Corruption, create distance so the tendrils don’t reach you.

Vayne.build: Survive early with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Build armor first to mitigate the physical damage from Vayne Q Tumble and Vayne E Condemn. Armor can’t reduce the true damage from Vayne W Silver Bolts, so don’t keep taking hits.
Vayne.combo: When Vayne Q Tumble is down and you’re in a position where Vayne E Condemn can’t knock you into a wall, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and fire Zeri Q Burst Fire repeatedly. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if you can keep attacking.
Vayne.escape: The moment after Vayne Q Tumble is used is your window to engage. If Vayne E Condemn is also down, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge from a position where you don’t have to worry about being stunned against a wall. If you’re in danger, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Vayne.fight: Right after you make Vayne use Vayne Q Tumble is your chance to close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge. Avoid positions where you can be knocked into a wall, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, and follow up with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash in fights where you can keep attacking.
Vayne.laning: Keep moving and farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire instead of overextending. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle to use a wall; if not, save it for when Vayne approaches. Pressure Vayne’s farming with the wave while she is weak early, but avoid positions where Vayne E Condemn can knock you into a wall.
Vayne.phase: Vayne has low health and armor early, so pressure her farming, but Zeri should focus on securing CS instead of forcing kills. Zeri gets stronger after two or three core attack speed and critical strike items, so use that power in mid-game fights. Vayne’s sustained damage becomes difficult to mitigate with defensive stats in late game, so secure objectives and towers in the early and mid game.
Vayne.teamfight: Avoid narrow paths and positions with a wall at your back; keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side in open areas. If you position near a wall without risking being knocked into it by Vayne E Condemn, you can secure both a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge.
Vayne.watch: Getting knocked into a wall and stunned by Vayne E Condemn is dangerous, so don’t fight with your back to a wall. Vayne W Silver Bolts deals true damage based on your maximum health when she keeps hitting the same target, so briefly leave her range if you’ve taken several consecutive attacks.

Xayah.build: Buy Cloth Armor first early on and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Xayah’s damage is mostly physical, and Zeri’s armor is relatively low, so build armor first.
Xayah.combo: After Xayah R Featherstorm is down, slow her with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and approach with Zeri E Spark Surge to set up the piercing shot from your next Zeri Q Burst Fire. Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash if the fight lets you keep attacking.
Xayah.escape: Before engaging, leave the recall path of Xayah E Bladecaller to avoid being rooted. When you need to disengage, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash, then cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Xayah.fight: Xayah’s feathers build up if you fight in the same spot for too long, so deal damage briefly and then reposition. If Xayah R Featherstorm is down and you’re out of the feather recall paths, close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge and fight.
Xayah.laning: Clear the wave with Zeri Q Burst Fire and collect CS without overextending. Poke with basic attacks charged by moving, and fire Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you can use a wall. Reposition after trades so Xayah’s feathers don’t build up.
Xayah.phase: Early on, Zeri should build CS and avoid Xayah’s feathers instead of forcing kills. Zeri’s strength rises sharply after two or three core attack speed and critical strike items, so look for fights where you can keep attacking then. The available information isn’t enough to judge which champion has the advantage in late game.
Xayah.teamfight: Keep landing Zeri Q Burst Fire from the side instead of initiating an engage on Xayah head-on. Near a wall, secure both a spread angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route for Zeri E Spark Surge. Once you confirm Xayah R Featherstorm is down, you can engage with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Xayah.watch: Xayah E Bladecaller roots you if you’re hit by three or more returning feathers. If three or more feathers on the ground form a line between you and Xayah, move sideways out of their return path instead of retreating straight back.

Yasuo.build: Weather the early game with Cloth Armor and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Yasuo’s main damage is physical, so build armor first.
Yasuo.combo: When Yasuo’s tornado is down and you have room to approach, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Follow up with Zeri E Spark Surge to close the gap and fire piercing Q Burst Fire repeatedly. Activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you’re in a position to keep attacking.
Yasuo.escape: Right after Yasuo throws his tornado, he briefly has no way to knock you up, so look to engage. Don’t go in immediately just because Yasuo E Sweeping Blade alone is down; close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge alongside crowd control before Yasuo R Last Breath comes back up. When you need to retreat, gain movement speed with Zeri R Lightning Crash and cross a wall with Zeri E Spark Surge.
Yasuo.fight: Trigger Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield with light poke before trading. You have an opening when Yasuo throws his tornado and his Q Steel Tempest stacks reset. If Yasuo W Wind Wall is available, change your angle for Zeri Q Burst Fire and look for an angle to poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser against terrain.
Yasuo.laning: Farm with Zeri Q Burst Fire and don’t overextend by standing too far forward. Keep the wave thin on your side to reduce the number of minions Yasuo E Sweeping Blade can dash through. Poke with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser when you have an angle against a wall, but save it to slow him if Yasuo can engage.
Yasuo.phase: Early on, watch for Yasuo’s approach and focus on farming with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Zeri gets much stronger in the mid game once she has two or three attack speed and critical strike core items, so take advantage of openings when Yasuo’s tornado is down. In the late game, keep Zeri R Lightning Crash active and fight from a position where you can keep attacking.
Yasuo.teamfight: Keep firing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a position along a wall on the flank instead of standing in front. From there, secure both an angle for Zeri W Ultrashock Laser’s terrain spread and an escape route over the wall with Zeri E Spark Surge. Use Zeri R Lightning Crash when you can keep attacking enemy champions after dodging Yasuo’s tornado and engage.
Yasuo.watch: After Yasuo lands Q Steel Tempest twice, his next Q comes out as a tornado and knocks you up, so when his stacks are full, move off the line and dodge to the side. Don’t insist on using Zeri Q Burst Fire in front of Yasuo W Wind Wall; change your angle.

Ziggs.build: Focus on building attack speed and critical strike. If you need resistances against Ziggs’s damage, build magic resistance rather than armor, and consider movement speed to help you leave the warned attack areas.
Ziggs.combo: When Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down and there’s an approach route without mines, slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser. Then close the gap with Zeri E Spark Surge, repeatedly fire piercing Zeri Q Burst Fire, and activate Zeri R Lightning Crash when you’re in a position to keep attacking.
Ziggs.escape: The window to engage opens after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. Approach with Zeri E Spark Surge from a direction not blocked by Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield.
Ziggs.fight: Close the gap right after Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. Slow him with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser, then approach with Zeri E Spark Surge and keep firing Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Ziggs.laning: Don’t overextend with your short range. Dodge Ziggs’s poke while clearing the wave and farming with Zeri Q Burst Fire. Poke Ziggs when he’s backed against a wall with Zeri W Ultrashock Laser against terrain, and don’t enter paths covered by mines. If the turret in Ziggs’s lane has lost a lot of health, don’t leave the wave unattended.
Ziggs.phase: Early on, dodge Ziggs’s poke while farming, and only look for a fight during the brief window when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down. Zeri gets stronger after building two or three attack speed and critical strike core items, so in the mid and late game, look for fights where you can keep hitting with Zeri Q Burst Fire.
Ziggs.teamfight: Don’t group up in front; keep firing Zeri Q Burst Fire from a flank along a wall. From there, secure both the terrain spread from Zeri W Ultrashock Laser and an escape route over the wall with Zeri E Spark Surge. Look to approach when Ziggs W Satchel Charge is down, and move away from the center of the explosion when Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears.
Ziggs.watch: If you step on Ziggs E Hexplosive Minefield, the slow makes it hard to dodge his follow-up abilities, so detour along a path without mines or wait for them to disappear. When the warning area for Ziggs R Mega Inferno Bomb appears, move away from the center of the explosion even if you can’t get completely clear.
